title: Never-assertions over runs no longer exist
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. Decision 0092 no longer matches the current design.
decision: Never-assertions over runs were retired with live behavioural runs (0142): a never is part of an example's then, judged as the example is.
consequences: The record now states this as the standing rule.
